surface: Surface-present for all 22 `@tanstack/react-hotkeys@0.10.0` adapter exports plus the byte-identical `@tanstack/hotkeys@0.8.0` core re-export. One representative differential covers registration, shortcuts, sequences, enabled updates, and cleanup; the 41-case upstream suite is preserved but not adapted, so verification remains recorded-unverified.
divergences: `target` refs are plain `{ current }` objects (Octane has no `React.RefObject`); the `isRef` guard and behavior are otherwise identical.
ssr: Supported: every hook registers listeners in effects and resolves `document` lazily, so server rendering produces no registrations and no browser access (matching upstream's `typeof document` guards).
notes: Created for the tanstack-com benchmark's octane flavor (Phase 2c); exercised by that app's ApplicationStarter hotkeys surface.
Upstream `React`-prefixed type names (`ReactHotkeyRecorder`, `ReactHotkeySequenceRecorder`) are kept verbatim so ports only change the import specifier.
